name: pr_comments
description: Gather PR feedback (conversation, reviews, inline), skipping harness-authored comments; append bounded, provenance-labeled untrusted context from linked references. Input: repo (owner/name or URL), number.

repo.description: GitHub repository (owner/name or URL) that owns the PR.

repoUrl.description: Alternate spelling for 'repo'; used when 'repo' is not supplied.

number.description: PR number to gather feedback for.

headRepo.description: Head repository as 'owner/name', empty when unavailable.

headRepoUrl.description: Clone URL of the head repository, empty when unavailable.

feedback.description: Consolidated markdown blob of conversation comments, reviews, inline comments, and any linked context, for the coding agent.

commentCount.description: Count of conversation + review + inline comments (excluding harness-authored ones).

linkedReferences.description: Metadata (without content) for external URLs found in feedback and resolved as linked context.

linkWarnings.description: Warnings encountered while extracting or retrieving linked context.

linkCount.description: Number of linked references successfully resolved.

linkedContextChars.description: Total character count of resolved linked-context content appended to feedback.
